context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 蛍光/ボーイ/ソナタ/ネズミ/愛好/コメディ/明快/大作

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、新しい蛍光のシール、絵に貼ろうかな。
lines.en: Mom, can I put these new glow-in-the-dark stickers on my drawing?
lines.style: Bright, eager question. Quick tempo. Asks with genuine curiosity — wants her input, not just permission. Open, hopeful at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。ホテルのボーイさん、丁寧に、案内してくれたわね、旅行で。
lines.en: Sure. That bellhop at the hotel was so thoughtful with us on the trip, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Gentle pace. She's reflecting aloud, inviting agreement. A small smile in her voice — noticing kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ピアノで、簡単なソナタ、弾けるようになったよ、ぼく。
lines.en: I can play a simple sonata now on piano! I did it!
lines.style: Small pride breaking through. Careful tempo — not bragging, just sharing the fact. Soft confidence. Looks to her for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 絵本のネズミ、可愛いキャラね、翔くん、好きでしょ?
lines.en: That picture-book mouse is such a cute character — I know you like him, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost teasing but affectionate. She knows him well. Warm, easy tone. Inviting him to agree with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 昆虫愛好家のおじさん、お話、面白かったよ!
lines.en: That insect expert uncle was so interesting! His stories were really fun!
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Quick, animated. His excitement bubbles up naturally. Leans forward slightly — wants to share what he learned.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: コメディ番組、お父さんと、よく見てるね、夜。
lines.en: You and Dad watch the comedy show a lot at night, don't you?
lines.style: Soft observation. Peaceful tone — she's noticing their routine fondly. Not quite a question. Content in that small shared thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先生の説明、明快で、ぼく、よくわかったよ。
lines.en: The teacher explained it so clearly — I really understood everything today.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Even pace, steady. A moment of relief and confidence. Matter-of-fact pride — he's not exaggerating, just pleased.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 絵本作家の大作、書店で、見に行こうね、今度。
lines.en: Next time, let's go see the picture-book author's new book at the bookstore.
lines.style: Warm invitation. Gentle, but decided. Draws him in gently — planning something together. Closes with softness, like a gift offered.
